title: Founded Suntech Power in 2001 with Wuxi municipal government backing
statement: Founded Suntech Power in 2001 with Wuxi municipal government backing and led its rapid growth through a 2005 NYSE listing.
outcome: Suntech's 2005 listing made Shi briefly the richest person in China (peak net worth $2.9 billion in 2008) and triggered a wave of local-government investment in solar manufacturing across China.

title: Was forced to resign as CEO by Suntech's board in August 2012
statement: Was forced to resign as CEO by Suntech's board in August 2012, and was stripped of the executive chairman title in March 2013 amid the company's debt crisis.
outcome: Suntech defaulted on a $541 million bond, its main subsidiary Wuxi Suntech Power filed for bankruptcy protection after a group of eight Chinese banks petitioned a Jiangsu court, the company's market value collapsed from a peak of $16 billion to about $106 million, and Shi's personal fortune fell from $2.9 billion to under $250 million. Shi called his removal 'misconceived and unlawful,' disputing the board's characterization of the ouster, though the underlying financial collapse and bankruptcy filing are independently documented, undisputed facts.
